summary: Santander Holdings USA filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, announcing redemption of all 6,000 outstanding shares of its Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series H, and the corresponding 6,000,000 depositary shares (NYSE: SNUS PF H) at $25.00 per depositary share on December 15, 2026. A separately declared quarterly dividend of $328.125 per preferred share ($0.328125 per depositary share) is payable the same date to holders of record November 30, 2026. Broadridge Corporate Issuer Solutions acts as redemption agent; shares are held book-entry through DTC. Watch for redemption mechanics and any refinancing signal.
